en: "In a move that few fans nor media saw coming, <TeamName>'s unsettled <PreferredPos1> <FullPlayerName> has changed his mind and decided that he will stay at the club given the right offer. Previously the player was adamant that he would not be signing another contract but over the weeks his attitude has softened and now he is prepared to reconsider and pledge his future to the team. Fan reaction was mixed. One claimed that the player had ""...undermined the team"" while another said he was ""...delighted he's staying."" Now <ManagerName> has the task of getting the player's mind fully on his football and deciding whether to put a new deal in front of him."

"On the eve of the massive <CompetitionName> tie between <TeamName1> & <TeamName2>, <ManagerName> has been quick to talk about how much confidence he has in his team. ""They might be a slightly stronger team than us on paper perhaps, but the game isn't played on paper, and it's going to be an exciting day for the supporters facing their rivals early in the competition"" he began. ""But in all honesty I wouldn't swap any of my players for theirs. I've got a cracking bunch of lads, strength all over the pitch, and their team spirit is second to none. I think we'll be fine and I've every confidence that my team will handle the big occasion with no problem."" "

If <FullPlayerName> is really on the way out of <TeamName> then where are his likely destinations?  We took a poll of editors from the major football publications and the three teams thought to be the most likely destinations for the want away <PreferredPos1> were in order of votes: <TeamName3> followed by <TeamName4> and finally <TeamName2>. Quite whether any of these clubs would want the <PlayerAge> year old, is another matter. But the men at the helm of these esteemed publications tend to have their ears to the ground, so it would be no major surprise if one of those teams were the ultimate destination for the player should <TeamName> allow him to leave.

"\n\n<TeamName2> have been in excellent form in recent games and with <TeamName1>'s <PlayerName1> returning from loan the pressure for him to perform at his parent club is now on. A benchmark of performance been set by the fans and he replied by saying ""I always try and do my best no matter what club I'm playing for. But now I'm back I will try and help the club get up to speed."" <ManagerName1> also replied to the expectation set by the supporters ""I don't think there is any pressure on the lad since his return. However I do believe he played a big part in <TeamName2>'s good run so hopefully he can add some confidence to the team's game when he plays."""

"Goodbye & farewell to <FullPlayerName> from all of football. The sad news we had suspected was confirmed this morning, when an emotional <PlayerName> held a press conference at <TeamName> to announce that his recent injury had forced him to announce his retirement earlier than planned. ""Originally I intended to play out the season, but when I picked up the injury and it became clear that it was going to be a hard road back, I decided that it was probably for the best that I bow out now"" said the <PlayerAge> year old <PreferredPos1>. The press gave him a standing ovation at the end of the gathering and he left the room struggling to control his emotions."
